task_completion.description: 3D Slicer application is open with the MRHead volume loaded and visible in the slice viewers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer GUI is visible showing a brain MRI in the Red, Green, and Yellow slice views.

task_completion.description: The agent has navigated to an axial slice where the lateral ventricles (dark, butterfly-shaped fluid spaces) are clearly visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Red slice viewer (axial) shows the central fluid-filled cavities of the brain.

task_completion.description: An arrow markup tool has been used to place an arrow in the slice viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A graphical arrow element is visible overlaid on the MRI slice.

task_completion.description: The arrow is pointing specifically to the left lateral ventricle (the right side of the image in standard radiological view, or left side if neurological).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tip of the arrow is touching or pointing directly at one of the dark fluid-filled lateral ventricles.

task_completion.description: The arrow markup is labeled with the specific text 'Left Lateral Ventricle'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text reading 'Left Lateral Ventricle' is visible next to or attached to the arrow markup.

task_completion.description: The agent has triggered the save/capture functionality to create the screenshot at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog, a file browser showing the path ~/Documents/SlicerData/Screenshots/, or a terminal command confirming the file creation is visible.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the 3D Slicer GUI elements rather than just executing background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor, highlighted buttons, or open menus within the Slicer Markups or Data modules.

integrity.description: The image is a genuine render of the MRHead dataset, not a static placeholder image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Crosshair movements or slice offset changes are visible across different steps of the trajectory.

integrity.description: The annotation is a real Slicer markup, not text/arrows drawn over a screenshot using an external image editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The markup properties (e.g., control points, Slicer-specific glyphs) are visible in the Slicer 'Markups' module panel.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The MRHead dataset is a standard T1-weighted structural MRI. In the axial (Red) view, the lateral ventricles appear as dark (low signal) symmetrical structures in the center of the brain. Note that in radiological orientation, the 'Left' ventricle is on the right side of the screen.
